purpose: Teach: 一つ一つ/思いつい/ホラー/満点/秘訣/フィット/ネクタイ/香水

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お皿、絶対、一つ一つ、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、洗ってるの
lines.en: Sho, I'm watching you wash every single dish so carefully — I'm really serious about this.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost teasing. Gentle emphasis on 「絶対」. Amused at his concentration. Slow, lingering delivery, like she's noticing something tender in the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、新しい遊び、絶対、思いついた、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really, really came up with a new game! It's so cool!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy. Words tumble out. Genuine excitement, not performed. Slight breathlessness like he's been holding this in. Eyes wide with the need to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、ホラー、絶対、映画、絶対、まだ、絶対、早いわよ
lines.en: Sho, a horror movie is still too much for you — you're not ready yet.
lines.style: Steady, protective tone. Firm but not unkind. The voice of someone who knows him well enough to draw a line. No room for negotiation, but delivered with care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、テストで、絶対、満点、絶対、取ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got a perfect score on my test! I really did!
lines.style: Proud, almost bursting with it. Quick attack on the announcement. Slightly louder than before — he needs her to hear how big this is. Genuine, uncool pride of a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お料理の、本気で、絶対、秘訣、絶対、教えてあげる
lines.en: Sho, let me teach you the real secret to good cooking — I want to share that with you.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost intimate. Slow, deliberate pacing. Warm invitation in the voice. Slight lean forward, like she's letting him into something that matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、お靴、絶対、フィット、絶対、しないんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my shoes don't fit right — they're uncomfortable.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact complaint, but with a small self-aware quality underneath. Not whining, just factual. Slight wry undertone, like he knows this is small but it bothers him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、ネクタイ、絶対、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's tie looks really nice — he has good taste.
lines.style: Bright, approving observation. Light, warm tone. Quick delivery on the compliment. The voice of someone who's genuinely noticed and wants to say so.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ママの、本気で、絶対、香水、絶対、いい匂いだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom's perfume smells so good — I like it.
lines.style: Soft, close voice. Contented observation. The intimacy of a small child noticing something comforting about a parent. Slight lean-in quality, like he's sharing a small secret.
